died.name: Aurangzeb
died.cause: in a letter to his youngest son, Muhammad Kam Bakhsh
died.last_words: Wherever I look I see nothing but the Divinity.-I have committed numerous crimes and I know not with what punishments I may be seized.-The agonies of death come upon me fast.-I am going. Whatever good or evil I have done, it was for you. No one has seen the departure of his own soul; but I know that mine is departing.

died.name: Victims of the Balvano train disaster
died.cause: At around midnight on 3 March 1944, a freight train headed from Naples to Potenza came to a stop inside the Armi tunnel in the town of Balvano due to its inability to climb over an incline. Due to a combination of carbon monoxide produced by poor-quality coal used on the locomotives and the lack of ventilation inside the tunnel, at least 517 people (most of whom were stowaway passengers) died as a result of carbon monoxide poisoning. The disaster remains the deadliest train accident in Italian history.
